title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 17
paragraphs: In this sea-fight the Egyptians fought best among those serving Xerxes; among their other great deeds, they captured five Greek ships together with their crews. Among the Greeks, those who did best that day were the Athenians, and of the Athenians, Cleinias son of Alkibiades, who was serving with two hundred men and a ship of his own, supplying the expense out of his own pocket.
